rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now the queen, the strongest piece in the game. She is on d1.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: She combines the two moves you already know: the rook's and the bishop's.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: She moves in straight lines or diagonally, as many squares as she likes, with a clear path.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Take the queen to h5 in a single move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! She went diagonally, like a bishop.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The queen goes up the diagonal to h5, like a bishop.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: The queen stopped on another square. Let's go back: the target is h5, at the end of the diagonal.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Take the queen to h5 in a single move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: From the same square, she can also go up the whole file, like a rook.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Up to d8, all at once.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: In each move she picks a single line: straight or diagonal.
rot.ideia.ex1.l4: Remember the idea: the queen moves like the rook and like the bishop.
rot.ideia.ex1.l5: Now let's see where she gets in two moves.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The queen is in the corner, on a1. Your goal is to take her to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: No line from a1 passes through h7: it will take two moves.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: Look for the square in between: one on a line of the queen and on a line through h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: What is the queen's first move towards h7? Suggest one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! From a7 the queen already sees h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: One route: up the a-file to a7, then along the rank to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.a1h1.1: That's right! From h1 the queen also sees h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.a1g7.1: That's right! From g7 the queen also sees h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.a1h8.1: That's right! From h8 the queen also sees h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.a1b1.1: That's right! From b1 the queen also sees h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.1: From a8, none of the queen's lines passes through h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.2: Let's go back and look for a square that lies on a line through h7.

rot.ideia.ex2.volta: What is the queen's first move towards h7? Suggest one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: From there she moves along the seventh rank to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: There were other two-move routes: via h1, via g7, via h8 or via b1.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: For example: going up the long diagonal to g7...
rot.ideia.ex2.l5: With so many lines, the queen nearly always gets where she wants in two moves.
rot.ideia.ex2.l6: Remember the idea: look for the square on one of the queen's lines and on one of the target's lines.
rot.ideia.ex2.l7: You now know how the queen moves. Now I will show her in other positions.
rot.demos.centro.e1: Look at the queen in the centre, on d4.
rot.demos.centro.e2: From here she reaches twenty-seven squares: eight directions, all clear.
rot.demos.centro.l1: She can go to a7, diagonally...
rot.demos.centro.l3: In the centre, the queen reaches almost half the board.
rot.demos.cercada.e1: Now the queen on d4 has white pawns around her.
rot.demos.cercada.e2: She does not jump over pieces: on lines with a pawn she stops before it; on the others she goes to the edge.
rot.demos.cercada.l1: Along the clear diagonal, she reaches h8.
rot.demos.cercada.l2: Even the strongest piece depends on open lines.
rot.demos.misturando.e1: The queen on h1 wants to reach b4.
rot.demos.misturando.l1: First the diagonal to e4, which is on the same rank as b4...
rot.demos.misturando.l3: A diagonal and a straight line: the queen mixes both moves.
rot.demos.misturando.l4: Now it's your turn: in the next positions, take the queen to the stars.
rot.pratica.estrelas1.enunciado: Take the queen to the three stars, stopping on each one, in any order you like.
rot.pratica.estrelas1.fim: Perfect. She went straight and diagonally, as the path required.
rot.pratica.estrelas2.enunciado: Now there are pawns on the d-file. Take the queen to the stars.
rot.pratica.estrelas2.fim: Well done. You now know how to move the queen: like the rook and like the bishop, with a clear path.
